title: Get lifetime access to 20TB of cloud storage for $315
excerpt: We found a way to stop renting your cloud storage.
content_html:
TL;DR: Stop worrying about your digital storage with this 20TB lifetime subscription to Scramble Cloud Storage for just $314.96 (reg. $1,440) with code CLOUD through Nov. 8.

Credit: Scramble Cloud

$314.96
$1,440 Save $1,125.04

The more you use your devices, the more digital files you accumulate. Since we’re all glued to our smartphones, we’re constantly saving content, taking photos, and capturing videos — and all those files need to go somewhere. Scramble Cloud Storage lets you secure 20TB of storage to keep all your content safe.

Right now, you can lock in this 20TB lifetime subscription to Scramble Cloud Storage for just $314.96 with code CLOUD until Nov. 8.

Secure your digital life with 20TB of cloud storage

Our digital lives aren’t shrinking anytime soon. If you’re looking for a more permanent option to keep them secure, it’s time to consider owning your cloud storage instead of renting it. With Scramble Cloud Storage, you can pay once and lock in a lifetime of space — with no monthly subscription costs or renewal fees required.

This lifetime subscription to Scramble Cloud Storage gives you an ample 20TB of space, enough to grow with you for life. Store your photos, videos, and important files securely, with peace of mind thanks to its end-to-end encryption and GDPR compliance. The zero-knowledge architecture also ensures you’re the only one who has access to your files.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

Scramble Cloud Storage lets you retain control over your content with an easy-to-use interface you can use on all your devices. Access Scramble via web app, desktop, WebDAV, or CLI.

There’s a 5GB maximum file size and a 70GB daily upload limit. Once you have uploaded your content, you can take advantage of unlimited file sharing. If you have friends who use Scramble Cloud Storage, you can also create groups for even easier sharing.

When you need to access your content, you can easily preview your files and view Word and Excel files right in your browser. You can easily manage it all thanks to the drag-and-drop interface.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

This lifetime subscription includes ongoing platform updates, so your Scramble Cloud Storage account will always be up to date.

Score a 20TB lifetime subscription to Scramble Cloud Storage for just $314.96 with code CLOUD now through Nov. 8.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
